explanation: Count the number of current versus prior holdings per BDC using the holdings and filings tables, and find the top 5 BDCs with the largest net increase.
raw: {"sql": "SELECT f.name AS bdc_name, SUM(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'current' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'prior' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS holding_increase FROM holdings h JOIN filings f ON h.adsh = f.adsh GROUP BY f.name ORDER BY holding_increase DESC LIMIT 5", "explanation": "Count the number of current versus prior holdings per BDC using the holdings and filings tables, and find the top 5 BDCs with the largest net increase."}
